mapper.select:

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, username_cn, nickname, email, password, account_type, position, phone_number, branch, ic_number, bank_name, bank_account, home_address, current_address, city, state, postcode, date_of_birth, gender, nationality, race, emergency_contact_name, emergency_phone_number, bank_account_holder_en, registration_code, is_first_login) VALUES (#{username}, #{usernameCn}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{password}, #{accountType}, #{position}, #{phoneNumber}, #{branch}, #{icNumber}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{homeAddress}, #{currentAddress}, #{city}, #{state}, #{postcode}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{gender}, #{nationality}, #{race}, #{emergencyContactName}, #{emergencyPhoneNumber}, #{bankAccountHolderEn}, #{registrationCode}, #{isFirstLogin})
